standouts.head: Quiet selling on the dip
standouts.text: Volume on the current pullback runs 39% below its 50-day average: profit-taking, not an exit.
standouts.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.

against.head: Weekly chart: declining
against.text: Price is below a falling 30-week average: the declining stage.
against.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

against.head: Bounce in a downtrend
against.text: Price has bounced above its 50-day average but stays under the falling 200-day, with the 50-day below the 200-day.
against.learn: A rise inside a downtrend; sellers often return at resistance.

against.head: The trigger failed before
against.text: It closed above the trigger line once since Nov 2 and gave it back.
against.learn: A line price closed above and then gave back has failed once already; the next break has to hold to count.

material.head: SPY: below its 200-day
material.text: SPY, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the Nov 6 low, the average price paid since the Jul 28 high and the 38.2% retracement of the Oct 1–Nov 10 rise, where 5 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: An ascending triangle
material.text: Sellers have capped it at the same level twice while each dip stops higher: pressure building under the ceiling.
material.learn: A flat ceiling with rising lows: buyers keep paying more.

material.head: Next support −2.4% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −2.4% below (1 ATR), where 4 levels (3 kinds) meet: the 200-week average, the average price paid since the Oct 1 low and the 50% retracement of the Oct 1–Nov 10 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
